messages:
nina: FYI partner (Olivia) flagged missing artifacts for their marketplace listing: SOC2 evidence mapping, pen test scope with IP ranges, firmware checksum, and a signed KMS attestation. Need quick plan to ingest and redaction flow.

olivia: Hi all 994f6 We need to publish the listing but security says we can't surface raw pen report or unredacted runbooks. Can you share allowed upload methods?

sam: We can accept presigned S3 uploads (short-lived) or SFTP. Pen report must be PII-redacted before it lands in public bundle. KMS attest needs signer identity + cert.

rahul: Presign approach looks simplest. Proposal: presign prefix marketplace/partners/olivia-inc/<release>/ and expire links at 20 minutes. Enforce PutObject with Content-MD5 check to verify firmware checksum.

nina: Good. Olivia, can your team produce checksum and KMS-signed attestation PDF? If not, we can help sign with our partner key but that adds compliance review.

olivia: We can produce checksum (sha256) and a minimal attestation PDF. Pen team will need guidance on what to redact.

sam: Redaction checklist: remove customer IPs, contact emails, internal hostnames; token values; anonymize usernames. Provide a redaction template we expect.

compliance-bot: created ticket INC-9012 for temp ingest creds + redaction runbook. ETA 48h. Link: https://internal.redwood/ingest/INC-9012

rahul: Example presign CLI for infra (awsv2):
```bash
aws s3 presign put-object --bucket redwood-marketplace-artifacts --key marketplace/partners/olivia-inc/release-202604/pen-report-redacted.pdf --expires-in 1200
```
Note: include x-amz-content-sha256 on uploads for integrity. Multipart presign supported; will need separate init/part URLs.

nina: Action items: (1) @sam will publish redaction template and quick checklist to the sheet (due tomorrow noon). (2) @rahul will create presign svc-account with prefix-scoped PutObject and multipart support, expiry 1200s (due EOD today). (3) @olivia will confirm they can produce sha256 + attestation PDF and confirm upload window (due today).

olivia: acked. Can confirm upload window: Tue 10-12 PT. We'll try to do single-file uploads <100MB but fall back to multipart if needed.

sam: Also need SOC2 evidence mapping: label each artifact with control IDs (CC, PI, etc.). I'll draft a mapping doc and add to the shared sheet.

rahul: One more infra caveat: for attestation PDFs we should require server-side KMS encryption on S3 (SSE-KMS) and a lifecycle to move to secure archive after bundle publish. Will add policy snippet to sheet.

nina: Perfect. If partner is blocked we can offer SFTP ingest behind a one-time creds flow (compliance-bot ticket).

compliance-bot: temporary sftp creds request created #INC-9013 if needed.

nina: Thanks everyone. Ill update the marketplace listing tracker with ingest plan and owners. If anything slips, escalate to partnerships-ops. :+1:
